user_requirements: FINAL CROSS-CONSISTENCY REVIEW before client send. The corpus contains the complete deliverable set for ASG's LCF Pilot accountability package: REPORT.md (the 8-page Accountability & Value Report), DATA_SUMMARY.pdf (2-page data handout), DATA_SUMMARY.xlsx (workbook with Summary / Weekly Averages / Week by Week / Daily Data sheets), weekly_reports_totals.txt (the current HOTC Weekly Data Reports the client holds), plus source-of-truth files (final_stats.txt, daily_data.csv, baseline_and_yoy.txt, lcf_contract_facts.txt). Your job: (1) CROSS-CHECK EVERY SHARED FIGURE across all artifacts — totals (406/4354/156/142/79/39/35/30/13/48), weekly averages, baseline and 2025 comparators, arrest figures (1.9 vs 1.2/wk, +58%, ~1-in-3 vs ~1-in-4 police engagements), capacity figures (211/29%, 3 instances ~1%), week-by-week rows — and flag ANY number that differs between any two artifacts; (2) verify FRAMING consistency: the deployment model must everywhere be ONE additional LCF-funded uplift team (afternoons Sun-Thu sector-split with the core patrol; nights Fri-Sat) on top of the existing 24/7 core programme — flag any residual instance of outdated framings such as 'two additional teams', 'enlarged combined team' in a daytime sense, 'normalised' terminology, 'team busy' jargon, a named cafe in the capacity instances, or the phrase 'ASG Security' used as the preparing entity (must be 'Absolute Security Group'); (3) verify the reporting windows are stated consistently (pilot 2 Jun - 24 Jul; data 1 Jun - 18 Jul incl. disclosed mobilisation day; 48 days); (4) confirm no internal ASG operational matters leak anywhere (staffing gaps, equipment issues, internal reporting failures framed as failures); (5) sanity-check the xlsx sheet totals against daily_data.csv. Output a findings list with severity (BLOCKER / RECOMMENDED / OPTIONAL), exact artifact + location, current text/value, and exact correction. If a category is fully consistent, state that explicitly. Do not rewrite anything; findings only.
acquirer_context: The set goes to Heart of the City (Edward Caughey) on 27 July 2026 and onward to the joint LCF funding administrators at Auckland Council by 31 July. All artifacts must tell exactly one story with exactly one set of numbers. Preparing entity branding: 'Absolute Security Group'.
